game.title: Crusader Kings II
game.blurb: Medieval grand strategy game from Paradox Development Studio, published by Paradox Interactive, released 2012-02-13. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Strategy, Simulation. There is no story: chapters are themes drawn from the Steam achievements (dynasty, realm, faith, war and the special starts and regions they name).

chapters.title: Dynasty and Family
chapters.summary: Marriage, children, bloodlines, family friendships and dynasty score.

chapters.title: Character, Court and Council
chapters.summary: Ambitions, traits, duels, seduction, the council and favours, hunts, illness and other personal feats.

chapters.title: Realm and Titles
chapters.summary: Climbing from Count to Emperor, holding kingdoms and empires, and reforming tribal rule.

chapters.title: Faith and the Church
chapters.summary: Popes and antipopes, crusades, pilgrimages, reforming and spreading religions, and secret societies.

chapters.title: War, Raids and Intrigue
chapters.summary: Assassinations, wars, mercenaries, raiding and executions.

chapters.title: Trade and Merchant Republics
chapters.summary: Patricians and Doges, family palaces, trade posts and wealth.

chapters.title: The Steppe, India and China
chapters.summary: Steppe hordes and the Mongols, Indian kingdoms and religions, and dealings with the Emperor of China.

chapters.title: Historic Starts and Long Games
chapters.summary: Goals tied to a start date, bookmark or starting character, and playing whole games from 769, 867 or 1066 to 1453.

chapters.title: Shattered and Random Worlds
chapters.summary: Goals for games started in a Shattered World or a Random World.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 10340); RAWG also keeps "Crusader Kings II: Conclave" as its own entry, but no achievement names it, and no expansion or DLC name appears in the Steam achievement data, so no chapter is named after one. Steam app 203770 (schema name "Crusader Kings II"); none of its 161 achievements are hidden. This is a grand strategy sandbox with no story, so the nine chapters are our own theme groups: the regional chapter (steppe, India, China) and the two start chapters are named from words in the descriptions ("High Middle Ages" and "Age of the Mongols" bookmarks, starts in 769, 867 and 1066, Shattered World, Random World). Many achievements fit more than one theme; each goes to the first matching theme in this order: custom worlds, historic starts, region, trade, war and intrigue, dynasty, faith, character, realm. StrategyWiki has no page for "Crusader Kings II"; "Crusader Kings 2" was also tried and is missing too. crusaderkings.fandom.com answers the API but has no "Crusader Kings II" page ("Crusader Kings 2" and "Crusader Kings" were also missing), so Fandom is unverified.
